jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS role centered on CRM data integrity, dashboards, reporting automation, onboarding programs, process documentation, lead routing and cross-functional Sales/Marketing operations. This maps closely to Kevin’s CRM, automation, reporting, training and workflow-building experience.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 3–5 years specifically in Revenue/Sales/Business Operations within SaaS and strong Salesforce knowledge. Kevin should emphasize his Salesforce and systems work without overstating dedicated RevOps tenure.

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare technology implementation role owning enterprise onboarding, cross-functional delivery, customer relationships, adoption and process execution. Kevin’s healthcare operations, stakeholder coordination, onboarding, training and systems/project work are highly transferable.
jobs.gap: Arcadia prefers 3+ years leading healthcare software implementations and experience with claims/clinical data integration. Kevin should position his healthcare systems implementation work clearly but not claim technical integration expertise he does not have.

jobs.title: ERAS Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Excellent process-operations match: SOPs, business rules, workflows, onboarding lifecycles, escalations and coordination across Product, IT, Data Services and relationship teams align with Kevin’s operations, intake, training and systems/process ownership.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 8–10 years of related experience and 5–7 years managing a specialized program, making tenure the primary stretch.

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Associate
jobs.why: Behavioral-health startup building operating infrastructure for psychiatry practices, with payer research, planning, rapid execution and data-driven operations. Kevin’s ABA/behavioral-health operations background and hands-on systems work make this a strong sector fit.
jobs.gap: The role includes analytical strategy work and outbound/campaign experiments; Kevin should lead with healthcare operations and systems ownership while using his marketing background as supporting experience.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: End-to-end healthcare software implementation, project leadership, client meetings, risk management and cross-functional coordination fit Kevin’s project-management, onboarding, training and healthcare operations experience.
jobs.gap: The posting specifically seeks healthcare software implementation and claims/clinical data integration experience, and some listings mention SQL/data tools. Kevin should keep SQL described only as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Regional Director of Operations - ABA
jobs.why: Direct ABA operations leadership role covering scalable systems, staffing, compliance, clinical/operational partnership and expansion. Kevin’s ABA intake, recruiting, training, workflow and operational systems experience is unusually relevant to the industry scope.
jobs.gap: This is a substantial seniority stretch: the role asks for 7+ years of progressive healthcare operations leadership, 5+ years of multi-site oversight and expansion experience.
